answer_1.quote: We evaluate GPT-2 Medium model on LoRA adapters, which are task-specific adapters that are fine-tuned on NLP task datasets. These tasks include converting tables (E2E), knowledge graph (WebNLG) and structured data (DART) to natural language. ... We evaluate model merging on three fine-tuned Llama-2-7B models focusing on different capabilities: Chinese language proficiency, mathematical reasoning, and code generation.
answer_1.outputs: Performance scores on generation benchmarks (e.g., NIST, CIDEr) and code generation (HumanEval).

answer_2.quote: Specifically, we compare Knots, which is designed specifically for LoRA merging. As shown in Table, STF outperforms existing baselines on all metrics. Specifically, comparing with previous best baselines, STF shows improvements of 2.2% for NIST of E2E, 4.8% over PCB-Merging for CIDEr of E2E.
